hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && if ! cd "$root" && pnpm build > /tmp/yayautomation-build.txt 2>&1; then jq -n --arg r "$(tail -40 /tmp/yayautomation-build.txt)" '{decision:"block",reason:("Build failed — fix errors before finishing:\n" + $r)}'; fi

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$root" && out=$(find includes yay-automation.php -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; 2>&1 | grep -v '^No syntax errors'); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg r "$out" '{decision:"block",reason:("PHP lint failed:\n" + $r)}'; fi
